articles.title: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show
articles.snippet: A wallet supposedly linked to Trump Media has made a large BTC transfer to Crypto.com, data tracked by Arkham show.

articles.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
articles.snippet: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
articles.snippet: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.
